assist.exactQuestion: Acquire source-addressed downside, execution-risk and falsifier evidence Alpha can reuse without setting Alpha's numeric risk or score.

claims.claim: Infleqtion's Q2 operating loss of $29.9M exceeded adjusted quarterly revenue of $13.5M, so commercialization growth has not yet demonstrated self-funding economics; Alpha should treat sustained loss-to-revenue conversion as an execution-risk input rather than infer risk from growth alone.

Q2 operating cash flow benefited from a temporary payroll-tax timing item; the issuer described approximately $14M of operating cash burn excluding that benefit. This is a source-addressed falsifier for any claim that one quarter of positive reported operating cash flow proves durable self-funding.

The Q2 revenue/guidance revision was described as an accounting timing correction without stated cash or underlying-business impact. It is therefore a reporting-quality uncertainty to monitor, not evidence by itself of economic deterioration.

riskSupport.risk: Commercial growth may fail to convert into durable self-funding if operating losses and normalized cash burn remain large relative to revenue.
riskSupport.observedWeakness: Q2 GAAP operating loss materially exceeded adjusted quarterly revenue, and normalized operating cash burn remained negative after removing the temporary payroll-tax timing benefit.
riskSupport.uncertainty: The durability of future gross margin, customer concentration and normalized cash burn remains Alpha-owned underwriting work.
riskSupport.improvementPath: Demonstrate repeated quarters of revenue growth accompanied by improving loss-to-revenue and normalized cash-burn ratios, with contract/customer economics that corroborate commercialization quality.
riskSupport.falsifier: This risk would weaken materially if subsequent primary filings show sustained normalized operating cash generation or a clear, source-addressed path to it without relying on temporary working-capital timing benefits.

riskSupport.risk: Forward quantum milestones may not translate into scalable customer economics even when technical progress is genuine.
riskSupport.observedWeakness: Current disclosures support technical and partnership progress, while utility-scale fault-tolerant execution and customer economics remain forward objectives.
riskSupport.uncertainty: Independent verification of logical-qubit milestones and economic advantage for customer workloads remains incomplete.
riskSupport.improvementPath: Add independently verifiable performance evidence plus customer deployment economics showing repeatable workload advantage and paid expansion beyond demonstrations or conditional awards.
riskSupport.falsifier: This risk would weaken if independent benchmarks and customer disclosures establish repeatable economic advantage at scale.

contradictions.contradiction: Fast commercialization growth and strong liquidity coexist with operating losses substantially larger than quarterly revenue and with key utility-scale technical/economic milestones still forward-looking.
contradictions.disposition: Preserve as a real commercialization-stage tension; it supports risk treatment but is not a present blocker by itself. Deep Resolver retains contradiction disposition authority.

unknowns: Customer concentration, normalized gross margin and forward cash-burn durability remain Alpha-owned underwriting gaps.
Independent customer-level evidence of economic quantum advantage remains incomplete.

lineage.note: Bounded assist artifact; does not replace Beta's existing structural-causal or adversarial-red-team perspectives and does not set Alpha numeric risk or score.
